# Cell-type annotation figures

UMAP and marker-gene plots for the annotated single-nucleus data. Input files are listed below.



# 1. Packages and publication-data directory 
```{r}
###############################################################################
# snBD — Cell-type annotation figures
#
# Purpose:
#   Display an ACTIONet embedding and marker-gene violin plots.
#
# Inputs:
#   publication/data/: celltype_stats.tsv and sce_snBD_McLean_MtSinai.rds.
#   The input object must be compatible with ACTIONet and SingleCellExperiment.
#
# Outputs:
#   UMAP and marker-gene figures in publication/data/; rendered HTML when knitted.
#
# Method overview:
#   Load annotated data/palette, draw UMAP, reshape selected marker expression,
#   and draw violin plots in the same cell-type order used by the other notebooks.
#
# Dependencies:
#   data.table, SingleCellExperiment, ACTIONet, readr, Seurat, tidyr,
#   ggplot2, geneticToolBox; rmarkdown/knitr for rendering.
#
###############################################################################



library(data.table)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(ggplot2)
project_root <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("SNBD_ROOT", unset = "."))
publication_data <- file.path(project_root, "publication", "data")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = publication_data)
setwd(publication_data)
dir_publication <- "./"
```


# 2. Cell-type UMAP

```{r}
library(ACTIONet)

cols = fread('./celltype_stats.tsv')
cols$label <- 1:nrow(cols)
v_cols <- cols$color
names(v_cols) <- cols$celltype
v_cols

ace <-  readr::read_rds("sce_snBD_McLean_MtSinai.rds") # large file
g_all <- plot.ACTIONet(ace, ace$Celltype_inferred, palette = v_cols, label_text_size = 4)
pdf(paste0(dir_publication, "/p_all_UMAP.pdf"), width = 10, height = 7)
g_all
dev.off()

```




# 3. Marker-gene violin plots
```{r}

sce <-  readr::read_rds("sce_snBD_McLean_MtSinai.rds") # large file

df_cols = fread('./celltype_stats.tsv')
v_cols <- df_cols$color
names(v_cols) <- df_cols$celltype
v_cols

cell_type_order <- sort(unique(sce$Celltype_inferred))
cell_type_order

genes = c("SLC17A7", "CUX2", "RORB", "TLE4", "GAD2", "RELN", "PVALB", "SST", "SV2C", "PLP1", "VCAN", "SLC1A2", "CSF1R")

label_genes <- c("SLC17A7 (Pan-Ex)", "CUX2 (L2/3)", "RORB (L4)", "TLE4 (L5/6)", "GAD2 (Pan-In)", "RELN (Reelin)", "PVALB (PV)", "SST (SST)", "SV2C (Rosehip)", "PLP1 (Oli)", "VCAN (OPC)", "SLC1A2 (Ast)", "CSF1R (Mic)")


df <- sce[rownames(sce) %in% genes, ]
colData(df)

library(Seurat)

reducedDims(df) <- NULL
df_s <- Seurat::as.Seurat(df)
df_s 


data <- as.data.table(t(assay(df, "logcounts")), keep.rownames=TRUE)
data <- tidyr::gather(data, "group", "count", -rn)
data
data <- merge(data, as.data.table(df@colData,keep.rownames = TRUE)[, c("rn", "Cohort","Phenotype", "cell_group" ,"Celltype_inferred")], by = "rn")
setDT(data)

head(data)
setnames(data, "Celltype_inferred", "cell_type")


alpha <- 0.01
strip.color <- NULL
font.size <- 12
pt.size <- 0.1


data$group <- factor(data$group)
cell_type_order <- sort(unique(data$cell_type))

data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = genes, labels = label_genes)

# Cell-type order used across the annotation, GWAS and MR figures.
v_order_cell_type <- c( "Ex-L2", "Ex-L23", "Ex-L3", "Ex-L4_MYLK","Ex-L45_MET", "Ex-L45_LRRK1", "Ex-L5b_HTR2C", "Ex-L56", "Ex-L56_CC_NTNG2",  "Ex-L6_CC_SEMA3A", "Ex-L6b_SEMA3D", "Ex-L6b_SEMA3E", "In-Rosehip_CHST9", "In-Rosehip_TRPC3","In-Reelin","In-VIP", "In-PV_Chandelier", "In-PV_Basket", "In-SST",  "Oli", "OPC","Ast",  "Mic","Endo", "Pericytes")

p <- ggplot(data, aes_string("cell_type", "count", fill = "cell_type")) +
  geom_violin(scale = 'width', adjust = 1, trim = TRUE, size=0.3, alpha=0.5, color="pink") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits= v_order_cell_type)  +
  facet_grid( group ~.,  switch = "y") +
  xlab("") + ylab("")+
  theme(
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = font.size),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white",colour = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white",colour = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = font.size  ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, 
      colour = v_cols[v_order_cell_type], size = font.size-3),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'none'
  )

p


geneticToolBox::ggsave_all(sprintf(paste0(dir_publication, "%s"), "p_marker_gene_v3"), width = 9, height = 6)



```
